gaps.sentence: The old buses are being phased ___ next year.
gaps.explanation: phase out = stop using something gradually.

gaps.sentence: If the strike goes ___, deliveries will stop nationwide.
It took the committee weeks to wade ___ the paperwork.
gaps.hint: wade ___ = plod through a lot of
gaps.explanation: 'Wade through' = work slowly through a large amount of tedious material.

gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
The players are gearing ___ for the final.
gaps.explanation: gear up for = prepare for a big event.

gaps.sentence: It took him weeks to get ___ the flu.
gaps.explanation: get over an illness/upset = recover from it.

gaps.sentence: I stand ___ my decision — it was the right one.
gaps.explanation: stand by something = continue to support it; stand by somebody = help and support them.
